messages.author: 25e13e522040f0b9
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] R/qtlcharts in iPython Notebook
parts:
I figured out how to embed R/qtlcharts in an iPython Notebook. Here are the critical steps but I'm happy to give more details if you are interested.

from IPython.display import IFrame
%load_ext rpy2.ipython

 %%R
library(qtl)
library(qtlcharts)

# Load cross object
%%R -i cross_path
load(cross_path)

%%R -w 1000 -h 700
rfplot <- iplotRF(cross, chr=20)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(rfplot, file="iplotRF_chr_20.html")

IFrame(src='iplotRF_chr_20.html', width=1000, height=700)
